Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Diagnosis of periodontitis (stages III or IV) that may require periodontal surgery
  -  Have at least 10 teeth in function, excluding third molars
-  Present locations with probing depth (PS)> 6 mm in at least 30% of the teeth

right.raw_text: -  Present radiographic evidence of moderate-severe bone loss in at least 30% of the dentition

left.raw_text: gingivalis in subgingival samples taken at the screening  [AND] visit as well as in the post-scaling  [OR] and root planning visit and processed by culture

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Pregnant  [OR] or lactating women
-  Presenting systemic pathology  [OR] and / or taking medication that may affect the periodontal situation  [OR] and / or patients requiring antibiotic prophylaxis

right.raw_text: -  Have received systemic antimicrobial treatment in the previous 6 months

left.raw_text: -  Have received periodontal treatment in the 6 months prior to the beginning of the study

right.raw_text: -  Patients allergic to metronidazole, [OR]  or to any of the components of commercial formulations thereof (Flagyl®)

left.raw_text: -  Patients allergic to azithromycin, [OR]  or to any of the components of commercial formulations thereof (Zithromax®)

right.raw_text: -  Patients who refuse to sign the informed consent
